_comment: Measured from 3d-assets/living_room.blend (object loungeChairRelax(Clone)) with Blender 4.0.2, 2026-10-17. All values in Blender world units (meters). Sitter forward = world -X (chair faces the TV/conversation zone). DO NOT move the chair: canon placement locked.

backrest.face_plane: x = 3.268 at z=0.37 (seat level) leaning back to x = 3.305 at z=0.63
backrest.note: Backrest front face. Leans back ~8 deg from vertical. Top edge at z=0.63.

butt_target.note: Where the sitter's buttocks contact the seat: centered on the seat, biased toward the back so the back meets the backrest.

character.note: 0.925m scale LOCKED (armature object scale stays 1.0 as authored; never rescale). Faces -Y in armature space; the pose actions carry root yaw -90 deg + seat translation, so applying a pose action seats him automatically.

footrest.note: Footrest flap is EXTENDED in the current blend (reclined state). Nearly flat, top at z~0.10, in front of the seat.

seat_surface.note: Seat cushion top. Slight rise toward the back (2.8 deg) so the sitter does not slide forward.
